The aggregator's bill looks dense but is only three layers of multiplication; the CMA aggregates crust matter on demand: base cost §624,000 L/s§r on the plain tier, or §6240 L/s§r on the dense tier — nearly a thousand-fold apart.

The steam multiplier is a three-layer product: §1(1+mode+fortune)×(1+0.2×(dim slots−1))×(1+filter cost/100)§r; the targeted multiplier is §1+2500% ÷ the lowest-three weight sum§r.

Fortune caps climb with currency: §17§r bare, §111§r with a singularity, §115§r with a critical one — three currencies, three fortune caps.
